description: Triple RSI Mean Reversion (QuantifiedStrat): SPY only. 5-day RSI < 30 + falling 3 days + prior RSI < 60 + above 200-MA. Exit when RSI > 50. Backtest: 18 trades (2018-2026), 83% WR, 2.72 PF, 1.38R avg. 2.3 signals/year. Stock venue (2bps) — cost drag negligible.
falsification_criteria: Trailing PF < 1.15 over next 20 trades OR avg R < 0 for 10 consecutive trades

entry_logic: Rank the 31-name Hyperliquid perp universe on BTC-RESIDUALIZED 30-day momentum: regress each coin's daily returns on BTC daily returns (rolling 60d beta, estimated on data through t-1 to avoid look-ahead), build a residual-return series, rank on the residualized cumulative return. Long the top quintile. Strips the BTC-beta before ranking so the book is idiosyncratic alpha, not directional beta.
exit_logic: Weekly rebalance; partial-rebalance (kappa=0.5) with a no-trade band (0.25); BTC 200-DMA overlay scales gross to 0.5 when down. Exit on rank decay below the median. No leverage (gross exposure cap 1.0).
counterparty: Alt-coin momentum under-reaction that is idiosyncratic to the coin AFTER stripping the systematic BTC move: late trend-followers and delayed indexers who chase the residual drift rather than the BTC beta, paying the spread to catch up after the move. They accept the loss because they are chasing, not arbitraging, the cross-section.
falsification_criteria: Residualizing BTC FAILS to clear the overfit controls that sank the raw version: CPCV 10th-pct split PF < 1.0, OR PBO >= 0.30, OR DSR <= 0.95, OR the edge remains concentrated in < 2 BTC-beta clusters (i.e. the residual still carries systematic beta).
description: US-211: BTC-residualized cross-sectional momentum. Regress per-coin returns on BTC, rank on residuals to strip beta before ranking.

entry_logic: Fade crowded positioning when the hourly perp funding rate exceeds its trailing 95th percentile (funding extreme) AND open interest is still rising (OI-delta quadrant), using the HL funding percentile, the OKX funding SPREAD, and the OI-delta quadrant (positioning-conditioned, not the naked directional carry that structural analysis rejected).
exit_logic: Exit on funding mean-reversion below the 80th percentile, or a hard stop at 1x structure-wide ATR against the entry.
counterparty: Late retail longs crowding a high-funding regime — they accept negative funding carry because they are momentum-chasing, not carry-aware, so the unwind pays them to hold and price corrects against them.
falsification_criteria: Sharpe < 0.5 over 200+ trades, OR the HONEST funding-only edge (funding_pnl - execution_cost, with the basis-proxy contribution stripped) disappears when funding falls below the 80th percentile.
description: US-212: funding-extreme unwind at SWING horizon (4-48h). Positioning-conditioned re-spec of seed-pool HYP-01: funding > 95th %ile + OI rising + OKX funding spread + OI-delta quadrant.
